player_prompt.intro:
Yin abi kɔɔr kuɛ̈ɛ̈c {difficulty} RushHour. Kuɛ̈ɛ̈c kɛ̈ɛ̈c tɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kɔ̈k [X] ku jɔ̈l ya tɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈ athɛ̈ɛ̈r.
Kɛ̈ɛ̈c: [A+], [B-], ku kɛ̈ɛ̈. (+ = tɛ̈n, - = cɔ̈l).

invalid_move.no_car: Acïn kë ye cɔl '{car_id}' në biäk.

game_message.solved: Aci rot ye cuɔt piny! Yïn acï kä cï gɔ̈ɔ̈r bɛ̈n yök.

outcome.win: Käk cï kek bɛ̈n looi acï röt waar!
